name: EditTogether
description: Edit a level together in real time, on the same Wi-Fi or over the internet.

default-room-name.name: Default Room Name
default-room-name.description: Name used when you create a room. Your name in rooms is your Geometry Dash username.

max-participants.name: Max Participants
max-participants.description: Maximum players in rooms you host, including you. The limit is 100.

relay-url.name: Online Relay URL
relay-url.description: Address of the relay service used for online rooms. Only change it if you host your own (see the server folder).

auto-discovery.name: Automatic Room Discovery
auto-discovery.description: Refresh the room list automatically while Find Rooms is open.

debug-logging.name: Debug Logging
debug-logging.description: Write detailed network logs to the Geode log.
